paper_title: Tell2Design A Dataset for Language-Guided Floor Plan Generation
caption: Number of floor plans vs. number of rooms per floor plan in the T2D dataset.
model_annotation: The bar chart, titled “#Floor plan vs. #Room per floor plan,” illustrates the distribution of floor plans in the T2D dataset according to the number of rooms they contain, with the horizontal axis representing the number of rooms per floor plan (ranging from 4 to 8) and the vertical axis indicating the count of floor plans on a linear scale from 0 to 35,000. Each blue bar corresponds to a specific room count: 254 floor plans have 4 rooms, 5,788 have 5 rooms, 25,104 have 6 rooms, 29,278 have 7 rooms, and 20,364 have 8 rooms. The bars are arranged in ascending order of room count from left to right, with the tallest bar at 7 rooms (29,278) indicating the most frequent configuration, followed by 6 rooms (25,104), then 8 rooms (20,364), 5 rooms (5,788), and the shortest bar at 4 rooms (254). The chart includes “Restricted” watermarks in red at the top and bottom, suggesting limited access or usage rights.
